Supreme Court Rejects Asaram's Bail Plea on Medical Grounds

The Supreme Court of India has rejected Asaram's bail plea on medical grounds, citing a grave necessity for his health. Asaram was arrested in connection with a rape case involving a minor in Jodhpur. The court has issued a notice to the Rajasthan government on Asaram's plea challenging the Rajasthan High Court's judgment. This decision comes after Asaram's lawyers made an urgent plea if his health deteriorates, warranting medical attention.
